$comment: FamilyLife brand key colours, from the theme builder's request for fl. They match the fl ref layer of @cruglobal/cornerstone-design-system. Update them here and re-run tools/palette.mjs. This file is the seam: everything downstream is derived.
$rolesComment: The request mapped neutral to dark-green. Neutral sets body text, borders, lowered surfaces and the dark-mode page colour, so it points at the gray scale instead, the way Cru's neutral points at its light gray.
$fontsComment: FamilyLife uses Akkurat LL for both body and headings.
$metricsComment: Every value here is the reference theme's default, and tools/palette.mjs on main does not read metrics yet. They are kept so the file is ready when the generator learns them.
